claim: Conducting garment fit evaluation predominantly on static models leads to high time consumption and elevated product development costs in apparel manufacturing.
stance_target: time and cost pain points of traditional static fit evaluation in patternmaking and prototyping
scope_conditions: Apparel product development and fit evaluation of knitted garments
quoted_support: Apparel fit is influenced by body proportion, fabric, and design parameters, but much of the fit evaluation is carried out in a static model, which leads to time consumption and higher development costs.

claim: When pattern design parameters are varied across three levels in 3D CAD, low-stress mechanical properties of knitted fabrics interact significantly with pattern parameters, with cotton-lycra blended single jersey garments exhibiting lower ease allowance across body fit zones compared to 100% cotton.
stance_target: elastane/lycra composition alters ease allowance and strain across fit zones, requiring specific pattern adjustments by the patternmaker
scope_conditions: Men's basic crewneck T-shirt in cotton and cotton-lycra single jersey knitted fabric evaluated in 3D CAD
quoted_support: Virtual 3D fit software evaluates the fit zones of the garment by incorporating the low-stress mechanical properties of knitted fabrics into an avatar model. Desen parametreleri ve malzeme bileşimleri üzerinde önemli bir etki vardır; pamuk-likra giysiler çeşitli uyum bölgelerinde daha düşük rahatlık gösterir.
